setup_logging: setup colored logging with optional file output to an experiment folder using colorlog
colorize_text: colorize terminal text with ANSI escape sequences for improved readability
bold_text: display bold text in the terminal using ANSI escape sequences
log_progress_bar: create a LogProgressBar to log iteration progress and metrics at regular intervals
result_logger_log_metrics: log training metrics and summaries to all active experiment loggers like Tensorboard and Wandb
